metadata.description: Claude Code skills for designing on a Superdesign canvas without spending credits: one for phone apps (React Native / Expo handoff), one for websites and web apps (React / Next.js / Vite handoff).

plugins.name: superdesign-mobile
plugins.description: Design iOS and Android app screens (390 x 844, light and dark) on a Superdesign canvas and hand them off to React Native / Expo Router.

plugins.name: superdesign-react
plugins.description: Design websites and web apps as React (TSX) pages on a Superdesign canvas and hand them off to a Next.js or Vite app.
